params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Anonymous callers are limited to `view` and `embed`.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: type
params.description: Limit results to items of an object type.

params.name: subtype
params.description: Limit results to items of one or more object subtypes.

items.docs: Cross-content search returning lightweight `{id, title, url, type, subtype}` records. 74 objects were searchable at harvest time, spanning the post, page and the three custom post types.
